message.reasoning_content: Both probes confirm. Interesting: uint32 max itself gave correct row but 4294967291 fails. Mismatches confirmed with +1, cols wrapped to 4294967295 (= -1 mod 2^32, true col 6 - 7 = -1). Finalize both.
